summary.text: Rick Devoid is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 1 who has served since December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Devoid, listed by Ballotpedia as Ricky Devoid, was born in Concord, New Hampshire, and earned a high school diploma from Concord High School.
As of 2024 he was retired and had previously worked in law enforcement, sales and as a store manager.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he moved to Boscawen in 1993, worked for 30 years in a family business setting granite memorials, served more than sixteen years with the Weare Police Department, and was running a gunsmithing business in retirement.

In the same survey, Devoid listed his campaign messages as addressing the high cost of living, enforcing the Second Amendment and backing law enforcement, supporting fire and EMS services, opposing new taxes and seeking less government involvement.
